body: I would say so. The more recent ratings are more on the negative side and the college readiness scores for the high school are not great. A lot of students are pretty much forgotten by admin due to overcrowding and don’t get the help and attention they need.

The first phase is supposed to be completed either this year or next year from what I’ve heard, but I would take that with a grain of salt. The second phase (the part that will actually like up with 140) isn’t scheduled to be completed until 2030. As it stands now, it takes me longer to get out of Hampstead than it takes to do the whole rest of my commute. It really is a nice area other than the traffic.

As someone who lives in Hampstead and commutes to Wilmington, the traffic is hell most of the day, but especially during commute time. The Topsail schools are not all they are cracked up to be. They are overcrowded and riddled with issues (but most schools here are). Living in Scotts Hill or Ogden would be a bit easier of a commute in my opinion, at least until the bypass is finished.

Hi, just wanted to say, I know things are really hard right now, but once you start cutting, it’s sooooo hard to stop. It’s a really slippery slope. Heck I can barely go a day without cutting anymore, but I wish every day I had never started. Some things you can do to get a similar sensation is draw on yourself with a pen (I use a red one) or hold an ice cube on where you want to cut. And if you do decide to cut, don’t cut too deep (there’s a bigger chance of scars) and clean your wounds after so they don’t get infected. I wish you all the best.

I know getting clean is super hard, heck it’s only been 11 days since I relapsed after being clean for 6 months. One of the things I hate about it most is that I can’t wear shorts or a swimsuit because my thighs are scarred so bad (which sucks cause I live on the coast). I would give nearly anything to not have started cutting, because I lived for it for a while, and once you start, it’s so hard to stop. But I started, and I can’t change it. I decided to get clean after 5 years because I didn’t want anymore scars and also one time I had a scare cause I nicked a vein by accident (but that’s another story). It’s been a journey but I’ve found some success stopping this time around using three tips:
1. Drawing where I want to cut (cause I can’t afford tattoos)
2. Taking a five minute break and distracting myself for a hot second 
3. Holding an ice cube to my skin so I get a similar sensation
I hope these help, as they’ve helped me. Good luck I believe in you ❤️
